groups.note: County, municipal, school, and special-district names are keyed from official Goshen clerk general summaries (2018, 2020, 2022, 2024, and 2026), the official 2024 school-district recount, and the official 2026 GC school-board recount page bound in the official 2026 general PDF. Official 2014 and 2016 general canvasses are archived; 2014 is a scan that was not fully keyed here, so January 2015–2018 local rows are largely Not yet collected rather than invented, except official 2018 county and Torrington contests. Multi-county legislative seats use official SOS district-wide Total rows, with the official Goshen share noted. Official SOS shows a House District 10 Goshen sliver in 2014–2020 (with Laramie); official 2022+ SOS Goshen rows for H10 are blank after redistricting. Senate District 3 and House District 2 are Goshen, Niobrara, and Weston; House District 5 is Goshen-only. The Torrington mayor is elected on the official November ballot (official city Election Information page, four-year term), not chosen by the council. Official mid-term judicial vacancies are not invented; appointment start days are the first of the official month where the court page gives only the month. Niobrara County School District #1 and Platte County School District #1 and #2 appear on official Goshen canvasses as slivers; official whole-district Niobrara and Platte totals were not combined here, and those boards are not seated from the Goshen portion alone. Chugwater cemetery and fire results are official Goshen votes, with that same limitation noted. Lingle, Fort Laramie, and La Grange (official town spelling LaGrange) did not appear as mayor or council contests on the official 2018–2026 Goshen November general summaries; current holders are filled from official town pages and official town minutes, with sources and confidence noted on each term. The Town of Yoder has no official town page, official minutes, Wayback capture, or official SOS municipal canvass naming a current mayor or council in the sources searched, so those offices are not invented.
